item.title: There Are Magic Hexagons of Every Order
item.description:
📝 Magic Squares and Magic Hexagons You probably know about magic squares. We have algorithms for constructing normal magic squares of every order $n>2$. Every other line has an antipodal line with the sum of antipodal opposite numbers.
🔗 Read more: https://gukov.dev/math/2026/08/02/new-magic-hexagons.html
